AfricanRecipes.name: Akara
instructions: Soak black-eyed peas in water for 30 minutes, then rub between palms to remove skins. Rinse until water runs clear.
Blend peeled peas with onion, pepper, and salt until smooth and fluffy.
Heat oil in a deep pan or pot to 180°C (350°F).
Drop spoonfuls of batter into hot oil and fry until golden brown, turning occasionally.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
servingSuggestions: Serve with pap (corn porridge) or bread as a breakfast or snack.
Enjoy with pepper sauce or tomato stew.

AfricanRecipes.name: Biltong
instructions: Slice beef into 2-3 cm thick strips along the grain.
Mix salt, sugar, coriander, and pepper in a bowl.
Dip each strip in vinegar, then rub generously with spice mix.
Place in a non-metallic container, cover, and refrigerate for 12-24 hours.
Rinse briefly to remove excess salt, pat dry, and hang in a well-ventilated area or biltong box.
Dry for 3-5 days until firm but still slightly moist inside.
Slice thinly before serving.
servingSuggestions: Enjoy as a high-protein snack on its own.
Serve with cheese and crackers or add to salads for extra flavor.

AfricanRecipes.name: Bobotie
instructions: Soak bread slices in half a cup of milk for 5 minutes until softened, then squeeze out excess milk thoroughly.
In a large pan, sauté chopped onions in oil until translucent, then add minced beef and cook until browned and crumbly.
Stir in curry powder, soaked bread, apricot jam, and season with salt and pepper. Mix until well combined.
Transfer the beef mixture into a greased baking dish and press down evenly.
Beat eggs with the remaining half cup of milk, then pour evenly over the meat mixture.
Place bay leaves on top and bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35–40 minutes until the topping is set and golden brown.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with fragrant yellow rice (saffron or turmeric rice) and a side of fruit chutney, such as apricot or mango chutney.
Garnish with a few bay leaves before baking for authentic aroma.

AfricanRecipes.name: Bofrot
instructions: Dissolve yeast and 1 tsp sugar in warm water. Let sit for 10 minutes until frothy.
In a large bowl, mix flour, remaining sugar, and nutmeg.
Add yeast mixture and egg, then knead until smooth dough forms (5-7 minutes).
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours until doubled in size.
Heat oil to 180°C (350°F).
Drop spoonfuls of dough into hot oil and fry until golden brown, turning occasionally.
Drain on paper towels and roll in sugar if desired.
servingSuggestions: Enjoy warm with tea, coffee, or as a snack.
Can be served with jam or chocolate sauce for dipping.

AfricanRecipes.name: Bunny Chow
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onions until golden.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add meat and brown on all sides.
Stir in tomatoes, potatoes, and enough water to cover. Season with salt.
Simmer for 45-60 minutes until meat is tender and sauce has thickened.
Cut bread loaf into quarters and hollow out the centers.
Fill bread hollows with curry and serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve with the removed bread pieces for dipping.
Accompany with sambals (chopped tomato, onion, and chili relish).

AfricanRecipes.name: Chakalaka
instructions: Sauté onions in oil until translucent.
Add bell peppers and carrots, cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in curry powder and chili, cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and cook until softened.
Mix in baked beans and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a relish with pap (maize porridge), bread, or grilled meats.
Can be served hot or cold.

AfricanRecipes.name: Couscous
instructions: Bring water or broth to a boil with salt and butter/oil.
Remove from heat and stir in couscous.
Cover and let stand for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork before serving.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a base for tagines or stews.
Mix with roasted vegetables, herbs, and lemon juice for a salad.

AfricanRecipes.name: Doro Wat

ingredients.item: niter kibbeh (spiced butter) or regular butter

instructions: In a dry pan, cook chopped onions over low heat for 30 minutes until deeply browned (no oil).
Add niter kibbeh or butter, garlic, and ginger. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add berbere spice and cook for 10 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add chicken and enough water to cover. Simmer for 45-60 minutes until chicken is tender.
Add hard-boiled eggs and simmer for 10 more minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
servingSuggestions: Serve with injera (sourdough flatbread) to scoop up the stew.
Accompany with side vegetables or salad.

AfricanRecipes.name: Egusi Soup
instructions: Boil meat with onions and seasoning until tender. Reserve broth.
Mix ground egusi with water to form a paste.
Heat palm oil in a pot, add egusi paste and fry for 10 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add meat broth, meat, fish, and crayfish. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add chopped spinach and cook for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
servingSuggestions: Serve with pounded yam, fufu, or eba.
Enjoy with a side of protein like fish or meat.

AfricanRecipes.name: Fufu
instructions: Bring water to a boil in a large pot.
Gradually add flour while stirring vigorously with a wooden spoon.
Reduce heat and continue stirring until mixture thickens and becomes smooth.
Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
When dough pulls away from the sides of the pot, it's ready.
Wet your hands and shape into smooth balls.
servingSuggestions: Serve with soups like egusi, okra, or peanut soup.
Traditionally eaten by pinching off a small piece, making an indentation, and using it to scoop soup.

AfricanRecipes.name: Injera

ingredients.item: active dry yeast (optional, for faster fermentation)

instructions: Mix teff flour with water to form a smooth batter.
Cover and let ferment at room temperature for 2-3 days until bubbly and sour.
If using yeast, add after 1 day of fermentation.
Heat a non-stick skillet or traditional mitad over medium heat.
Pour batter in a circular motion from outside to center.
Cover and cook for 2-3 minutes until holes form and top is dry.
Remove without flipping (only one side is cooked).
servingSuggestions: Serve as a base for Ethiopian stews (wat) like doro wat.
Use as both plate and utensil - place stews on injera and tear pieces to scoop.

AfricanRecipes.name: Jollof Rice
instructions: Blend tomatoes, peppers, and one onion to make a smooth sauce.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté remaining onion until golden.
Add tomato paste and fry for 2-3 minutes.
Pour in blended sauce and cook for 20 minutes until thickened.
Add stock, thyme, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Bring to boil.
Add washed rice, stir, and reduce heat to low.
Cover and cook for 30 minutes until rice is tender and liquid absorbed.
Let rest for 10 minutes before fluffing with fork.
servingSuggestions: Serve with fried plantains, grilled chicken, or fish.
Can be served with coleslaw or salad on the side.

AfricanRecipes.name: Kenyan Nyama Choma
instructions: Cut meat into manageable pieces.
Mix lemon juice, garlic, ginger, and salt to make marinade.
Rub marinade thoroughly into meat and let sit for at least 2 hours (overnight is best).
Grill over medium-hot charcoal for 30-40 minutes, turning occasionally.
Baste with remaining marinade during grilling.
Cook until charred on outside and tender inside.
servingSuggestions: Serve with ugali (maize porridge) and kachumbari (tomato-onion salad).
Enjoy with cold Tusker beer, a Kenyan favorite.

AfricanRecipes.name: Mandazi
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, yeast, and cardamom in a bowl.
Gradually add coconut milk to form a soft dough.
Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Roll out dough to ½-inch thickness and cut into triangles or circles.
Heat oil to 180°C (350°F) and fry mandazi until golden brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a snack with tea or coffee.
Can be dusted with powdered sugar or served with fruit preserves.

AfricanRecipes.name: Matoke
instructions: Peel bananas/plantains and cut into chunks.
Sauté onions in oil until golden.
Add garlic, ginger, and tomatoes. Cook until tomatoes soften.
Add banana chunks and enough water to cover.
Season with salt and pepper, then simmer for 20-25 minutes until bananas are tender.
Mash slightly with a spoon to thicken the sauce.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a main dish with meat stew or beans.
Enjoy with rice or ugali for a complete meal.

AfricanRecipes.name: Moambe Chicken
instructions: Brown chicken pieces in palm oil and set aside.
In same pot, sauté onions until translucent.
Add tomato paste and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Return chicken to pot, add garlic, bay leaves, and enough water to cover.
Simmer for 40 minutes until chicken is tender.
Stir in peanut butter and cook for 10 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
servingSuggestions: Serve with fufu, rice, or boiled plantains.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro.

AfricanRecipes.name: Pap
instructions: Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a heavy pot.
Mix maize meal with remaining 2 cups of cold water to make a smooth paste.
Slowly add maize paste to boiling water while stirring constantly.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 15 minutes, stirring frequently to prevent lumps.
Add salt and continue cooking until thick and smooth.
For softer pap, add more water; for firmer, cook longer.
servingSuggestions: Serve with stews, curries, or chakalaka.
Can be eaten for breakfast with milk and sugar or as a savory side with meat dishes.

AfricanRecipes.name: Piri Piri Chicken

ingredients.item: piri piri chili peppers (or other hot chili)

instructions: Blend chilies, garlic, lemon juice, paprika, olive oil, and salt to make marinade.
Make deep cuts in chicken pieces and rub marinade thoroughly.
Marinate for at least 4 hours (overnight for best flavor).
Grill over medium heat for 25-30 minutes, turning and basting with marinade.
Alternatively, bake at 200°C (400°F) for 30-35 minutes.
Serve with extra piri piri sauce on the side.
servingSuggestions: Serve with Portuguese rolls or rice and a simple green salad.
Accompany with fries or roasted potatoes.

AfricanRecipes.name: Suya

ingredients.item: beef sirloin or chicken breast, thinly sliced

instructions: Thread meat onto skewers.
Mix suya spice with oil to form a paste.
Coat meat thoroughly with spice paste and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill over hot coals or under broiler for 5-7 minutes per side.
Turn and baste with remaining spice paste.
Serve immediately with sliced onions and tomatoes.
servingSuggestions: Traditionally served with sliced onions, tomatoes, and cabbage.
Can be served with bread or rice as a main dish.

AfricanRecipes.name: Tagine
instructions: Brown meat in tagine or heavy pot with oil.
Add onions, ginger, saffron, cinnamon, and enough water to cover.
Simmer covered for 1½ hours until meat is tender.
Add dried fruit and honey, cook for 20 more minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with toasted almonds before serving.
servingSuggestions: Serve with couscous or crusty bread to soak up the sauce.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and lemon wedges.

AmericanRecipes.name: Apple Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Place one pie crust in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large bowl, mix apples, sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, and lemon juice until coated.
Pour apple mixture into the crust-lined dish. Dot with butter pieces.
Cover with second crust, crimp edges, and cut slits in the top to vent.
Optional: Brush top with beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 45-55 minutes until crust is golden and filling is bubbly. Cool before serving.
servingSuggestions: Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
Excellent with a slice of cheddar cheese.

AmericanRecipes.name: Barbecue Ribs

ingredients.item: pork baby back ribs or spare ribs (rack)
dry barbecue rub (paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, etc.)

instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F (135°C). Remove membrane from back of ribs.
Generously coat ribs on all sides with dry rub.
Place ribs on foil, meat-side up. Sprinkle vinegar over ribs. Wrap tightly in foil.
Bake for 3-4 hours until tender.
Unwrap, brush generously with barbecue sauce.
Finish on a hot grill or under a broiler for 5-10 minutes until sauce is caramelized.
servingSuggestions: Serve with coleslaw, cornbread, and baked beans.
Have extra barbecue sauce on the side.

AmericanRecipes.name: Buffalo Wings

ingredients.item: chicken wings (split into drumettes and flats)
vegetable oil for frying (optional, for deep-fry method)

instructions: For Baking: Pat wings dry. Toss with baking powder, salt, and pepper. Place on a wire rack over a baking sheet.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 45-50 minutes until crispy.
For Frying: Heat oil to 375°F (190°C). Fry wings in batches for 10-12 minutes until golden and cooked through.
In a saucepan, melt butter and whisk in hot sauce.
Toss cooked wings in the sauce until fully coated.
Serve immediately with dressing and celery sticks.
servingSuggestions: Serve with celery sticks, carrot sticks, and blue cheese or ranch dressing.
Perfect for game day with a cold beverage.

AmericanRecipes.name: Caesar Salad
instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry romaine lettuce. Chop into bite-sized pieces.
If making dressing from scratch: blend anchovies, garlic, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, egg yolk, and olive oil.
In a large bowl, toss lettuce with dressing until lightly coated.
Add most of the Parmesan cheese and croutons; toss gently.
Plate the salad, top with remaining Parmesan and fresh black pepper.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a side to steak, chicken, or pasta.
Top with grilled chicken or shrimp for a main course.

AmericanRecipes.name: Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar, and melted butter. Press into bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.
Bake crust for 10 minutes. Cool slightly.
Beat cream cheese and 1 cup sugar until smooth. Beat in sour cream and vanilla.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing just until blended. Pour over crust.
Bake 50-60 minutes until center is almost set. Turn off oven; let cake cool in oven with door ajar for 1 hour.
Chill in refrigerator for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
servingSuggestions: Serve plain or with fresh berries, fruit compote, or chocolate sauce.
Garnish with whipped cream.

AmericanRecipes.name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a small bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla until creamy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.
Gradually beat in flour mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 9-11 minutes until golden brown. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes; transfer to wire racks.
servingSuggestions: Enjoy warm with a glass of milk.
Add nuts like walnuts or pecans for extra crunch.

AmericanRecipes.name: Clam Chowder

ingredients.item: clams, chopped (canned or fresh, with juice)

instructions: In a large pot, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove, leaving fat.
Cook onion and celery in bacon fat until soft, 5-7 minutes.
Stir in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly whisk in water/clam juice and juice from clams. Add potatoes and thyme.
Bring to a simmer, cook until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in clams, cream, and cooked bacon. Heat through (do not boil).
Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.
servingSuggestions: Serve in a bread bowl with oyster crackers on the side.
Garnish with fresh parsley.

AmericanRecipes.name: Cobb Salad

ingredients.item: red wine vinaigrette or blue cheese dressing

instructions: Arrange a bed of chopped lettuce on a large platter or individual plates.
Arrange rows or sections of diced chicken, eggs, avocado, tomatoes, bacon, and blue cheese over the lettuce.
Drizzle dressing over the top just before serving.
Alternatively, toss all ingredients in a large bowl with dressing.
servingSuggestions: Serve with crusty bread on the side.
A classic lunch or light dinner.

AmericanRecipes.name: Cornbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Grease an 8x8 inch pan or 9-inch skillet.
In a bowl, mix cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, and melted butter/oil.
Pour wet ingredients into dry; stir just until combined (a few lumps are okay).
Pour batter into prepared pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
servingSuggestions: Serve warm with butter, honey, or alongside chili or barbecue.
Great for breakfast or as a side.

AmericanRecipes.name: Donuts
instructions: Mix warm milk, yeast, and a pinch of sugar. Let sit 5-10 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, mix yeast mixture, sugar, eggs, melted butter, and salt.
Gradually add flour until a soft dough forms. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
Place in greased bowl, cover, let rise until doubled (1-1.5 hours).
Roll dough 1/2-inch thick. Cut into donut shapes.
Let shaped donuts rise 30-45 minutes.
Heat oil to 375°F (190°C). Fry donuts 1-2 minutes per side until golden. Drain.
Cool slightly, then coat in sugar, glaze, or icing.
servingSuggestions: Enjoy fresh with coffee or milk.
Top with chocolate glaze, sprinkles, or cinnamon sugar.

AmericanRecipes.name: Fried Chicken

ingredients.item: seasonings (paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper)

instructions: Optional: Brine chicken in buttermilk and hot sauce for 4-24 hours.
Heat oil in a heavy pot to 350°F (175°C).
Mix flour, cornstarch, and seasonings in a shallow dish.
Dredge chicken pieces in flour mixture, shake off excess.
Fry chicken in batches (do not overcrowd) for 15-20 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and internal temp reaches 165°F (74°C).
Drain on a wire rack over a sheet pan. Let rest 5-10 minutes before serving.
servingSuggestions: Serve with mashed potatoes, gravy, coleslaw, and biscuits.
Perfect for picnics or a Sunday dinner.

AmericanRecipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter one side of each bread slice.
Place one slice butter-side-down in a cold skillet over medium-low heat.
Add cheese slices, then top with second bread slice, butter-side-up.
Cook 3-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese is melted.
Press down lightly with a spatula. Let cool slightly before cutting.
servingSuggestions: Serve with tomato soup for dipping.
Add slices of tomato, ham, or bacon for variation.

AmericanRecipes.name: Hamburger
instructions: Gently form meat into 4 patties, slightly wider than the buns. Make a slight indent in the center of each.
Season patties liberally with salt and pepper.
Preheat grill or skillet to high heat. Cook patties 3-5 minutes per side for medium.
If using cheese, add during last minute of cooking to melt.
Toast buns lightly.
Assemble burgers with patties and desired toppings.
servingSuggestions: Serve with french fries, onion rings, and a pickle spear.
Customize with bacon, avocado, or a fried egg.

AmericanRecipes.name: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente. Drain.
In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly whisk in milk until smooth. Cook, stirring, until thickened.
Reduce heat to low. Gradually stir in cheese until melted and sauce is smooth.
Season with salt, pepper, and optional spices.
Stir in cooked macaroni. Serve immediately.
Optional: Pour into baking dish, top with breadcrumbs, bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes until bubbly.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a main dish with a green salad or as a side to grilled meats.
Add cooked bacon, broccoli, or lobster for variation.

AmericanRecipes.name: Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.item: potatoes (Russet or Yukon Gold, peeled and cut)

instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water, add salt.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer until tender (15-20 minutes). Drain well.
Return potatoes to pot over low heat for 1 minute to evaporate excess moisture.
Mash potatoes with a potato masher or ricer.
Add butter and stir until melted. Gradually add warm milk until desired consistency.
Season with salt and pepper. For extra creaminess, stir in sour cream.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a side with gravy, roasted meats, or stews.
Top with chives, roasted garlic, or more butter.

AmericanRecipes.name: Hot Dog

ingredients.item: hot dog franks (beef, pork, or chicken)

instructions: Grill, pan-fry, or simmer in water until heated through.
If grilling or pan-frying, cook for 5-7 minutes, turning until browned.
If boiling, simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Lightly toast buns if desired.
Place cooked frank in bun and add toppings.
servingSuggestions: Serve with french fries, potato chips, or baked beans.
A classic for ballgames and cookouts.

AmericanRecipes.name: Jambalaya
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, brown sausage over medium-high heat. Remove.
Season chicken with Cajun seasoning, brown in the same pot. Remove.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, and celery (the 'holy trinity') until soft.
Add rice, stir to coat. Add broth, tomatoes, and browned meats. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, simmer for 25 minutes.
If using shrimp, add during last 10 minutes of cooking.
Remove from heat, let stand covered for 5-10 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
servingSuggestions: Serve with hot sauce, green onions, and parsley on top.
Complements cornbread or a green salad.

AmericanRecipes.name: Pancakes

ingredients.item: butter or oil for greasing griddle

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour wet ingredients into dry; stir until just combined (batter will be lumpy).
Let batter rest for 5 minutes.
Heat a griddle or non-stick pan over medium heat; grease lightly.
Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form and edges look set (2-3 minutes).
Flip and cook until golden brown (1-2 minutes more).
servingSuggestions: Serve warm with maple syrup, butter, fresh berries, or whipped cream.
Great for breakfast or brunch.

AmericanRecipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak
instructions: Slice steak as thinly as possible (partially freezing helps).
Heat oil/butter in a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Sauté onions and peppers until soft and caramelized. Remove.
Add steak in a single layer, season with salt and pepper. Cook quickly until no longer pink.
Return onions/peppers to pan. Mix with steak.
Divide mixture into two piles, top each with cheese slices to melt.
Split rolls, toast if desired, and scoop cheesy steak mixture into rolls.
servingSuggestions: Serve with pickles, hot peppers, or ketchup on the side.
A classic street food-style sandwich.

AmericanRecipes.name: Meatloaf

ingredients.item: additional ketchup or glaze for topping

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
In a large bowl, soak breadcrumbs in milk.
Add all other ingredients except topping glaze. Mix gently with hands until just combined.
Shape mixture into a loaf on a baking sheet or in a loaf pan.
Spread topping glaze over the loaf.
Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, until internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
Let rest 10-15 minutes before slicing.
servingSuggestions: Serve with mashed potatoes, gravy, and green beans.
Leftovers make great sandwiches.

AsianRecipes.name: Bao Buns
instructions: Combine warm milk, yeast, and sugar. Let sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, mix flour and baking powder. Add yeast mixture and oil, knead into a smooth dough (8-10 mins).
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours, until doubled.
Punch down dough and divide into 8 equal pieces. Roll each into a ball, then flatten into an oval. Brush with oil, fold in half.
Place each bun on a parchment square. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes.
Steam buns over boiling water for 12-15 minutes. Serve warm.
servingSuggestions: Fill with char siu (Chinese BBQ pork), crispy pork belly, or braised mushrooms.
Serve with hoisin sauce and pickled vegetables.

AsianRecipes.name: Biryani
instructions: Marinate meat with yogurt, half the ginger-garlic paste, half the biryani masala, and salt for at least 1 hour.
Wash and soak rice for 30 minutes. Parboil rice with whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom, cinnamon) until 70% cooked. Drain.
Fry onions in ghee/oil until golden brown. Remove half for garnish.
In the same pot, add remaining ginger-garlic paste, marinated meat, and cook for 15-20 mins until meat is tender.
Layer cooked meat, then rice, fried onions, mint, cilantro, and saffron milk. Repeat.
Cover with tight lid. Cook on low heat (dum) for 20-25 minutes. Fluff gently and serve.
servingSuggestions: Serve with raita (yogurt sauce) and a hard-boiled egg or salad.
Pair with a mirchi ka salan (chili curry) for a classic Hyderabad-style meal.

AsianRecipes.name: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, half the ginger-garlic paste, half the garam masala, and salt for at least 1 hour. Grill or pan-fry until charred. Set aside.
In a pan, melt butter. Add remaining ginger-garlic paste, cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, sugar, salt, and remaining garam masala. Cook for 10-15 mins until oil separates.
Add cream and kasuri methi (crushed). Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cooked chicken pieces. Simmer for another 5-10 minutes until chicken is tender and sauce is rich.
servingSuggestions: Serve with naan bread or steamed basmati rice.
Garnish with a swirl of cream and fresh cilantro.

AsianRecipes.name: Chow Mein
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Rinse with cold water, toss with a little oil to prevent sticking. Set aside.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add garlic, stir for 30 seconds. Add chicken/shrimp and stir-fry until cooked through.
Add all vegetables and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add cooked noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss everything together for 2-3 minutes until heated through and well coated.
servingSuggestions: Serve immediately as a main dish.
Garnish with sliced green onions and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.

AsianRecipes.name: Dim Sum (Shumai)

ingredients.item: green peas or carrot dice for garnish

instructions: Mix pork, shrimp, mushrooms, cornstarch, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl until sticky.
Place a wonton wrapper on your palm. Add a tablespoon of filling. Gently squeeze the wrapper around the filling, leaving the top exposed. Flatten the bottom.
Top each shumai with a green pea or carrot dice.
Line a steamer basket with parchment or cabbage leaves. Place shumai inside, ensuring they don't touch.
Steam over boiling water for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with chili oil, soy sauce, or black vinegar for dipping.
Traditionally enjoyed with Chinese tea (Yum Cha).

AsianRecipes.name: Dosa
instructions: Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek seeds separately for 6 hours.
Grind urad dal with water to a smooth, fluffy batter. Grind rice to a slightly grainy paste. Mix both batters together with salt.
Allow batter to ferment in a warm place for 8-12 hours, until doubled and bubbly.
Heat a non-stick tawa or griddle over medium heat. Pour a ladleful of batter in the center, spread outwards in a thin, circular motion.
Drizzle oil/ghee around edges. Cook until the bottom is golden and crisp. Flip if desired, or fold and serve.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with sambar (lentil stew) and coconut chutney.
For masala dosa, place a portion of spiced potato filling in the center before folding.

AsianRecipes.name: Fried Rice
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Scramble eggs, then remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil. Stir-fry garlic for 30 seconds, then add vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add cold rice, breaking up any clumps. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss to combine.
Return eggs and any cooked protein to the wok. Add green onions. Toss everything together for 1 minute.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a main dish or side with other Chinese entrees.
Top with extra chopped green onions or a drizzle of chili oil.

AsianRecipes.name: Kimchi
instructions: Cut cabbage into quarters, then into 2-inch pieces. Dissolve salt in water, pour over cabbage. Let sit for 2 hours, turning occasionally. Rinse thoroughly and drain.
Mix gochugaru with a little warm water to form a paste.
In a large bowl, combine drained cabbage, radish, carrot, garlic, ginger, fish sauce, sugar, green onions, and gochugaru paste. Mix thoroughly with gloves.
Pack mixture tightly into a clean jar, pressing down to remove air bubbles. Leave 1-2 inches of space at the top.
Seal jar and let ferment at room temperature for 2-5 days (taste daily). Then refrigerate.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a side dish (banchan) with rice and other Korean meals.
Use in kimchi fried rice, kimchi jjigae (stew), or as a topping on noodles.

AsianRecipes.name: Laksa
instructions: Cook noodles according to package directions. Drain and divide among bowls.
In a pot, fry laksa paste for 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Add stock and coconut milk. Bring to a simmer. Add chicken/prawns and tofu puffs. Cook until protein is done.
Top noodles with bean sprouts, then ladle the hot soup, protein, and tofu over.
Garnish with egg halves, cilantro, mint, and a squeeze of lime.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of sambal (chili paste) for extra heat.
Garnish with sliced red chili and Vietnamese coriander (laksa leaf).

AsianRecipes.name: Mapo Tofu
instructions: Blanch tofu cubes in salted water for 2 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok. Cook ground pork until no longer pink. Add doubanjiang, garlic, and ginger. Stir-fry for 2 mins until fragrant and oil turns red.
Add stock and soy sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Gently add tofu cubes. Simmer for 5 minutes, spooning sauce over tofu.
Stir in cornstarch slurry to thicken sauce. Sprinkle with ground Sichuan peppercorns and green onions.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot over a bowl of steamed white rice.
The classic numbing, spicy flavor pairs well with a simple stir-fried vegetable.

AsianRecipes.name: Mochi
instructions: Mix mochiko, sugar, and water in a microwave-safe bowl until smooth. Cover with plastic wrap.
Microwave on high for 2 minutes. Stir well with a wet spatula. Microwave for another 1-2 minutes until dough is translucent and elastic.
Dust a work surface with cornstarch. Transfer hot dough onto it. Dust top and a rolling pin.
Roll dough into a rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick. Cut into squares.
Place a small ball of anko in the center of each square. Pinch edges together to seal, forming a ball. Dust with more starch.
servingSuggestions: Enjoy as a sweet treat with green tea.
Can be filled with ice cream (mochi ice cream) or strawberries.

AsianRecipes.name: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak noodles in warm water for 30 minutes until pliable but firm. Drain.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar for the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok. Fry tofu/shrimp until cooked. Push aside, add garlic, shallot, dried shrimp. Stir, then push aside.
Crack eggs into center, scramble, then mix with other ingredients.
Add drained noodles and sauce. Toss and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until noodles are tender.
Turn off heat. Stir in bean sprouts and half the peanuts. Serve with lime and remaining peanuts.
servingSuggestions: Serve immediately with extra lime wedges, bean sprouts, and chili flakes on the side.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and chives.

AsianRecipes.name: Paneer Tikka
instructions: In a bowl, mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, all spices, kasuri methi, lemon juice, salt, and 1 tbsp oil.
Add paneer and vegetable cubes. Gently coat. Marinate for at least 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers, alternating paneer and vegetables.
Grill on a barbecue, in an oven (200°C/400°F), or on a stovetop grill pan, turning occasionally, until charred in spots (10-15 mins).
servingSuggestions: Serve hot as an appetizer with mint chutney and onion rings.
Can be wrapped in a roti or naan with chutney to make a roll.

AsianRecipes.name: Pho

ingredients.item: bean sprouts, basil, lime, chili, hoisin, sriracha

instructions: Char onion and ginger over open flame or under broiler until blackened. Rinse.
Parboil beef bones for 10 minutes, then rinse clean.
In a large pot, add bones, charred onion/ginger, spices, fish sauce, sugar, and cover with water. Simmer for 3-4 hours. Skim scum. Strain broth, season with salt.
Soak rice noodles in hot water until soft. Drain.
Arrange noodles in bowls, top with raw beef slices. Pour boiling hot broth over beef to cook it.
Serve immediately with herbs, bean sprouts, lime, and sauces on the side.
servingSuggestions: Customize with bean sprouts, Thai basil, lime juice, sliced chilies, hoisin, and sriracha.
A side of crispy fried dough (quay) is a popular addition.

AsianRecipes.name: Ramen

ingredients.item: pork bones (for tonkotsu) or chicken bones
soy sauce, miso, or salt for tare (seasoning)
aromatic oil (like garlic or scallion oil)

instructions: Make broth: Simmer pork/chicken bones for 4-6 hours (for tonkotsu, boil vigorously). Skim scum. Strain.
Prepare toppings: Soft-boil eggs (6.5 mins), marinate in soy-mirin mix. Braise pork belly for chashu.
Cook noodles according to package (usually 2-3 mins for fresh).
Assemble: Place tare in bowl. Add hot broth. Add drained noodles. Arrange toppings: chashu slices, halved egg, menma, nori, green onions. Drizzle with aromatic oil.
servingSuggestions: Serve immediately. Slurp noodles while hot.
Customize with additional toppings like corn, spinach, or spicy bean paste.

AsianRecipes.name: Satay
instructions: Blend shallots, garlic, lemongrass, and spices with oil to form a paste.
Marinate meat cubes in the paste for at least 2 hours.
Thread 3-4 pieces of meat onto each skewer.
Grill over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until cooked and slightly charred (8-10 mins).
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with peanut sauce, ketupat (rice cakes), and a side of cucumber-onion salad.
Drizzle with kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) and a squeeze of lime.

AsianRecipes.name: Spring Rolls
instructions: Prepare all fillings and have them ready in separate bowls.
Dip a rice paper wrapper in warm water for 5-10 seconds until pliable. Lay flat on a damp cloth.
On the lower third, layer lettuce, herbs, noodles, carrots, cucumber, and protein.
Fold sides inward, then tightly roll from the bottom up, like a burrito.
Repeat with remaining wrappers and fillings.
servingSuggestions: Serve immediately with nuoc cham (dipping sauce) or hoisin-peanut sauce.
Best enjoyed fresh, as the rice paper can harden if left too long.

AsianRecipes.name: Sushi (Nigiri & Maki)
instructions: Cook sushi rice. Mix vinegar, sugar, salt; fold into warm rice. Cool to room temp.
For Nigiri: Wet hands, take a tbsp of rice, form an oval. Dab wasabi, top with a slice of fish.
For Maki: Place nori on bamboo mat. Spread a thin layer of rice, leaving a 1-inch border at top.
Arrange fillings (cucumber, avocado, fish strips) in a line across the rice.
Using the mat, roll tightly from the bottom, sealing the edge with water. Slice with a wet knife.
servingSuggestions: Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.
Pair with miso soup and a simple green salad.

AsianRecipes.name: Tandoori Chicken
instructions: Make deep cuts in the chicken pieces.
Mix yogurt, lemon juice, all spices, ginger-garlic paste, and coloring to form a marinade.
Coat chicken thoroughly. Marinate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Place chicken on a wire rack over a baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until cooked through and charred in spots. Baste with oil/melted butter halfway.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with mint chutney, onion rings, and lemon wedges.
Excellent as an appetizer or main course with naan and salad.

AsianRecipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
instructions: Bring stock to a boil. Add lemongrass, galangal, lime leaves, and chilies. Simmer for 10 minutes to infuse.
Add mushrooms and protein. Cook until protein is done (shrimp turns pink, chicken cooked through).
Add tomatoes and cook for 1 minute.
Turn off heat. Stir in fish sauce and lime juice. Taste and adjust sour/salty balance.
Garnish with cilantro and serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve steaming hot as a soup course or with steamed jasmine rice as a main.
Add a spoonful of nam prik pao (chili jam) for a richer, slightly sweet version (Tom Yum Nam Khon).

FusionRecipes.name: Sushi Burrito

ingredients.item: imitation crab sticks or cooked shrimp

instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package instructions. While hot, mix with rice vinegar and let cool slightly.
Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat or piece of plastic wrap. Spread a thin, even layer of rice over most of the sheet, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Arrange crab sticks, cucumber, avocado, and carrot in a line down the center of the rice.
Using the mat or plastic wrap, tightly roll the nori into a burrito shape, sealing the edge with a bit of water.
Slice in half and serve with soy sauce for dipping.
servingSuggestions: Serve with pickled ginger, wasabi, and extra soy sauce.
Drizzle with spicy mayo or eel sauce for added flavor.

FusionRecipes.name: Butter Chicken Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Roll out pizza dough or place naan on a baking sheet.
Spread a generous layer of butter chicken sauce over the dough, leaving a small border for the crust.
Top with shredded chicken, red onion, and mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly.
Remove from oven, drizzle with yogurt/cream, and garnish with fresh cilantro.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of raita or extra butter chicken sauce for dipping.
Pair with a crisp green salad.

FusionRecipes.name: Tandoori Chicken Taco
instructions: Marinate chicken cubes in tandoori paste and yogurt for at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Cook chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat until fully cooked and slightly charred, about 10-12 minutes.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Assemble tacos: place chicken on tortilla, top with cabbage, red onion, and a drizzle of mint chutney.
Serve immediately with lime wedges.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of cucumber raita and mango chutney.
Add sliced jalapeños for extra heat.

FusionRecipes.name: Kimchi Quesadilla
instructions: Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place one tortilla in the skillet. Sprinkle with a layer of cheese, then add kimchi, optional meat, and green onions. Top with more cheese and a second tortilla.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, carefully flip, and cook another 2-3 minutes until golden brown and cheese is melted.
Remove, cut into wedges, and repeat with remaining ingredients.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a dipping sauce of sour cream mixed with gochujang.
Pair with a simple cucumber salad.

FusionRecipes.name: Paneer Alfredo Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
In a large pan, heat butter over medium. Lightly fry paneer cubes until golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté garlic until fragrant. Add cream, parmesan, and garam masala. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Add cooked pasta, paneer, and spinach (if using) to the sauce. Toss to combine, adding pasta water if needed to loosen sauce.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot.
servingSuggestions: Garnish with fresh cilantro or parsley.
Serve with garlic naan or crusty bread.

FusionRecipes.name: Thai Green Curry Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.
If using meat/seafood, cook in a large pan until nearly done. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté curry paste for 1 minute. Add coconut milk and broth, whisking to combine. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook until tender-crisp. Return meat to pan and add fish sauce.
Add cooked pasta to the sauce, tossing to coat. Stir in basil just before serving.
servingSuggestions: Garnish with lime wedges, sliced red chili, and crushed peanuts.
Serve with a side of crispy shallots.

FusionRecipes.name: Masala Mac & Cheese
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Cook, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Reduce heat to low. Stir in shredded cheese until melted. Add garam masala, turmeric, salt, and pepper.
Add cooked macaroni and peas (if using) to the cheese sauce. Stir until fully combined and heated through.
servingSuggestions: Top with breadcrumbs mixed with melted butter and a pinch of masala, then broil until golden.
Garnish with chopped cilantro or green onions.

FusionRecipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Burger
instructions: In a bowl, mix ground chicken, panko, and 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce. Form into 4 patties.
Cook patties on a grill or skillet over medium heat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through. Brush with extra teriyaki sauce in the last minute.
Grill pineapple rings for 1-2 minutes per side.
Mix mayonnaise with sriracha (if using).
Toast burger buns. Assemble burgers: spread spicy mayo on bun, add lettuce, chicken patty, and a grilled pineapple ring.
servingSuggestions: Serve with sweet potato fries or a side of edamame.
Drizzle with extra teriyaki sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

FusionRecipes.name: Ramen Burger
instructions: Cook ramen noodles according to package (discard seasoning packets or save for another use). Drain well and let cool.
Beat 1 egg and mix with cooked noodles. Divide mixture into two piles. Form each into a bun shape in a greased, round mold (like a tuna can) or free-form into a patty.
Pan-fry noodle buns in oil over medium heat until crisp and golden on both sides. Set aside.
Cook burger patties to desired doneness, seasoning with soy sauce in the last minute.
Fry the 2 remaining eggs sunny-side up or over-easy.
Assemble burger: Place one ramen bun, top with arugula, burger patty, fried egg, scallions, and drizzle with sesame oil. Top with second ramen bun.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of kimchi or pickled vegetables.
Drizzle with Japanese mayonnaise and tonkatsu sauce.

FusionRecipes.name: Samosa Chaat Nachos
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Spread tortilla chips on a large oven-safe platter.
Mix mashed potatoes, peas, and chaat masala. Warm mixture in a pan or microwave.
Spoon the warm potato mixture over the tortilla chips.
Drizzle generously with yogurt, tamarind chutney, and mint chutney.
Sprinkle with sev. Bake for 5-7 minutes just to warm through. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Garnish with chopped red onion, cilantro, and diced tomato.
Serve immediately as the chips can get soggy.

FusionRecipes.name: Butter Paneer Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Mix ricotta cheese with chopped spinach.
Spread a thin layer of butter paneer sauce on the bottom of the dish. Arrange 4 lasagna noodles over the sauce.
Layer with half the ricotta-spinach mixture, half the paneer cubes, and a third of the mozzarella. Spoon over a third of the remaining sauce.
Repeat layers (noodles, ricotta, paneer, mozzarella, sauce). Top with final 4 noodles, the rest of the sauce, and remaining mozzarella. Drizzle with heavy cream.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 15 more minutes until bubbly and golden. Let rest 10 minutes before serving.
servingSuggestions: Garnish with fresh cilantro and a drizzle of cream.
Serve with garlic naan or a simple salad.

FusionRecipes.name: Korean BBQ Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Roll out pizza dough or place naan on a baking sheet.
Spread the gochujang-honey mixture over the dough as the sauce.
Sprinkle with half the cheese. Top with cooked bulgogi beef and red onion. Add remaining cheese.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until crust is done and cheese is melted.
Remove from oven and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.
servingSuggestions: Drizzle with a little sesame oil or sriracha mayo after baking.
Serve with a side of kimchi.

FusionRecipes.name: Wasabi Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 15-20 minutes. Drain well.
Return potatoes to the pot and mash over low heat to evaporate excess moisture.
Add butter and warm milk, and mash until smooth and creamy.
Stir in wasabi paste, starting with 1 tbsp and adding more to taste. Season with salt.
Garnish with chopped chives before serving.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a side with grilled fish or steak.
Top with a pat of butter and extra chives.

FusionRecipes.name: Tikka Masala Fries

ingredients.item: frozen french fries or potato wedges
cooked chicken tikka pieces or paneer

instructions: Bake or air-fry french fries according to package directions until crispy.
While fries cook, warm the tikka masala sauce and chicken/paneer in a saucepan.
Preheat broiler. Place cooked fries on an oven-safe platter or in a skillet.
Top fries with the warm tikka masala mixture. Sprinkle generously with cheese.
Broil for 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with cilantro and red onion. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of raita or mint chutney for dipping.
Top with a dollop of yogurt or spicy mayo.

FusionRecipes.name: Sushi Pizza

ingredients.item: imitation crab, smoked salmon, or tuna

instructions: Press warm sushi rice into four 1/2-inch thick round patties. Pan-fry in a little oil until crisp on both sides, or bake at 400°F until firm.
Mix Japanese mayo and sriracha to make spicy mayo.
Place a rice 'crust' on a plate. Spread a thin layer of spicy mayo.
Top with crab/salmon, avocado, and cucumber.
Drizzle with more spicy mayo and sprinkle generously with furikake and crumbled nori.
servingSuggestions: Serve with soy sauce, pickled ginger, and wasabi on the side.
Garnish with tobiko (flying fish roe) or sesame seeds.

FusionRecipes.name: Falafel Taco

ingredients.item: falafel mix or homemade falafel balls

instructions: Prepare falafel according to package or recipe. Form into small, flattish patties if needed for tacos.
Cook falafel in oil until golden brown and heated through.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Assemble tacos: place 1-2 falafel in a tortilla, top with tomato, cucumber, red onion, and parsley.
Drizzle generously with tzatziki or tahini sauce.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of hummus and pickled turnips.
Add a squeeze of lemon juice and crumbled feta cheese.

FusionRecipes.name: Miso Glazed Salmon Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Mix miso, mirin, and soy sauce. Brush over salmon fillets.
Bake salmon for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through and glaze is caramelized.
Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
In a large pan, heat sesame oil and sauté garlic until fragrant. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Add cooked pasta to the pan with spinach. Flake the baked salmon into large chunks and add to pasta. Toss gently, adding pasta water as needed to create a light sauce.
servingSuggestions: Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve with a wedge of lime or lemon.

FusionRecipes.name: Pesto Paneer Sandwich

ingredients.item: ciabatta rolls or thick bread slices

instructions: Lightly pan-fry or grill paneer slices until golden on both sides.
Slice ciabatta rolls in half and toast lightly.
Spread pesto on both halves of the roll.
On the bottom half, layer arugula, paneer slices, roasted red peppers, and mozzarella.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze if using, then top with the other half of the roll.
Press gently and serve. Can be grilled like a panini for a warm sandwich.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of sweet potato fries or a simple soup.
Drizzle with chili oil for extra heat.

FusionRecipes.name: Chilli Paneer Wrap
instructions: Sauté paneer cubes in a little oil until lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté onions and bell peppers until tender-crisp. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add soy sauce and chilli sauce. Return paneer to the pan and toss to coat. Cook for 2 more minutes.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Place a lettuce leaf on each tortilla. Spoon the chilli paneer mixture onto the lettuce.
Roll up tightly, tucking in the sides as you go. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of schezwan mayonnaise or sweet chilli sauce for dipping.
Pair with a cooling cucumber raita.

FusionRecipes.name: Chocolate Samosa

ingredients.item: samosa pastry sheets or spring roll wrappers

instructions: Mix chopped chocolate, nuts, and marshmallows/chocolate chips in a bowl.
Cut samosa sheets into rectangles or strips. Place a spoonful of filling near one corner.
Fold the corner over the filling to form a triangle. Continue folding in a triangle pattern until the sheet is used up. Seal the edge with a paste of flour and water.
Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry samosas until golden brown and crisp, about 2-3 minutes. Drain on paper towels.
Dust with powdered sugar while still warm.
servingSuggestions: Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or a drizzle of caramel sauce.
Sprinkle with sea salt for a sweet-salty contrast.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Margherita Pizza

ingredients.item: gluten-free pizza sauce or tomato puree

instructions: Preheat oven as per crust instructions (typically 425°F/220°C).
Place gluten-free crust on a baking sheet or pizza stone.
Spread pizza sauce evenly over the crust, leaving a small border.
Arrange mozzarella slices evenly over the sauce.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and oregano.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until cheese is bubbly and crust is golden.
Remove from oven, top with fresh basil leaves, slice, and serve.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of gluten-free garlic bread or a fresh green salad.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze for extra flavor.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Veg Supreme Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Par-cook harder veggies (like bell peppers) in a pan with a little oil for 5 minutes if desired for softer texture.
Place crust on baking sheet. Spread sauce evenly.
Sprinkle half the cheese over the sauce.
Arrange all vegetables evenly over the cheese.
Top with remaining cheese and sprinkle with Italian seasoning.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese is golden.
Let cool for 2-3 minutes before slicing.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of gluten-free ranch or marinara for dipping.
Pair with a cold beverage like fresh lime soda.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Cheese Burger (Lettuce Bun)

ingredients.item: large iceberg or butter lettuce leaves

instructions: Gently mix ground beef with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Form into two patties slightly larger than your cheese slices.
Heat a grill or skillet over medium-high heat. Cook patties for 3-4 minutes per side for medium, or to desired doneness.
In the last minute of cooking, place a cheese slice on each patty and cover to melt.
Wash and dry lettuce leaves. Use two large leaves or stack 2-3 smaller leaves per 'bun' side to create stability.
Place cheese patty on one lettuce 'bun'. Top with tomato, onion, pickles, and condiments.
Top with the second lettuce 'bun' and secure with a toothpick if needed. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve with crispy french fries or a quinoa veggie salad.
Use gluten-free bacon or avocado as additional toppings.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Veg Burger

ingredients.item: egg or flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp water)
gluten-free burger buns or lettuce wraps

instructions: In a large bowl, mash beans with a fork, leaving some texture.
Add quinoa/breadcrumbs, carrot, onion, garlic, spices, salt, pepper, and binder (egg). Mix well to combine.
Form mixture into 4 patties, about 3/4-inch thick. Chill for 15 minutes if time allows (helps firm up).
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook patties for 5-7 minutes per side, until golden brown and heated through.
Toast gluten-free buns if using. Assemble burgers with patties and desired toppings.
servingSuggestions: Serve with gluten-free garlic bread or sweet potato fries.
Top with gluten-free barbecue sauce or a spicy mayo.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Chicken Burger

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thigh fillets
gluten-free all-purpose flour or almond flour

instructions: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness (about 1/2 inch) if using breasts.
Marinate chicken in gluten-free soy sauce, 1 tbsp olive oil, and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Dredge marinated chicken in gluten-free flour, shaking off excess.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken for 6-7 minutes per side, until internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).
Alternatively, grill on a preheated grill for same time.
Toast gluten-free buns. Spread with mayo, add lettuce, then the cooked chicken patty, and top with tomato, onion, and pickles.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of gluten-free caesar salad or crispy french fries.
Add avocado or bacon for a richer burger.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Alfredo Pasta

ingredients.item: gluten-free fettuccine or pasta of choice

instructions: Cook gluten-free pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water according to package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, melt butter in a large skillet or saucepan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant (do not brown).
Pour in heavy cream, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Gradually whisk in Parmesan cheese until smooth and melted.
Season sauce with salt, white pepper, and nutmeg.
Add drained pasta to the sauce, tossing to coat. Add reserved pasta water a little at a time if sauce is too thick.
Garnish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan before serving.
servingSuggestions: Serve with gluten-free garlic bread and a simple green salad.
Top with grilled chicken or shrimp for added protein.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Arrabiata Pasta

ingredients.item: red chili flakes (adjust to heat preference)

instructions: Cook gluten-free pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add sliced garlic and chili flakes. Cook for 1-2 minutes until garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Pour in crushed tomatoes. Add salt and sugar (if using). Stir well.
Bring sauce to a simmer, then reduce heat to low. Cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens slightly.
Add cooked pasta to the sauce, tossing to coat. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce.
Stir in fresh herbs just before serving.
servingSuggestions: Top with fresh basil and grated Parmesan or dairy-free alternative.
Serve with a side of gluten-free garlic bread to soak up the sauce.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Mac & Cheese

ingredients.item: shredded Gruyere or Monterey Jack cheese

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) if making baked version.
Cook pasta according to package directions in salted water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in gluten-free flour and cook for 1 minute to form a roux.
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Add mustard powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Cook, whisking constantly, until sauce thickens and comes to a gentle simmer (about 5-7 minutes).
Remove from heat. Gradually whisk in shredded cheeses until completely melted and smooth.
Combine cheese sauce with drained pasta. Serve immediately for stovetop style.
For baked: Transfer to a greased baking dish, top with breadcrumbs, and bake for 20 minutes until bubbly and golden.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a main dish with a side of gluten-free caesar salad or steamed broccoli.
Add cooked bacon, jalapeños, or lobster for a gourmet twist.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Caesar Salad

ingredients.item: Caesar Dressing: anchovy paste or minced anchovies
Caesar Dressing: salt and black pepper

instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry romaine lettuce. Chop into bite-sized pieces.

To make dressing: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, anchovy paste, garlic, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper until smooth. Thin with a little water if too thick.
In a large salad bowl, combine chopped romaine, most of the Parmesan, and most of the croutons.
Drizzle desired amount of dressing over the salad and toss gently to coat.
Top with remaining Parmesan and croutons. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Add grilled chicken, shrimp, or salmon to make it a complete meal.
Serve as a starter before a pasta dish like gluten-free alfredo.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Greek Salad
instructions: In a large salad bowl, combine cucumber, tomatoes, bell pepper, red onion, and olives.
In a small jar or bowl, whisk together all dressing ingredients until emulsified.
Pour dressing over the vegetables and toss gently to combine.
Add cubed feta cheese and fresh oregano. Toss very gently once more to distribute without breaking up the feta too much.
Let salad sit for 5-10 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a light lunch or as a side with grilled lamb or chicken.
Enjoy with gluten-free pita bread on the side.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Quinoa Veggie Salad
instructions: In a saucepan, combine rinsed quinoa and water/broth. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 12-15 minutes until liquid is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and let cool.
In a large bowl, combine cooled quinoa, tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, red onion, and herbs.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour dressing over the quinoa-veggie mixture and toss well to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Top with crumbled feta or diced avocado if desired. Serve chilled or at room temperature.
servingSuggestions: Perfect as a standalone light meal, side dish, or packed for lunch.
Pair with grilled fish or tofu for added protein.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Crispy French Fries

ingredients.item: optional seasonings: paprika, garlic powder, black pepper

instructions: Peel potatoes (optional) and cut into even 1/4 to 1/2-inch thick sticks. Soak in cold water for 30 minutes to remove excess starch. Drain and pat completely dry with towels.
In a deep fryer or heavy pot, heat oil to 325°F (160°C).
Fry potatoes in batches for 5-6 minutes until cooked through but not browned (blanching). Remove and drain on paper towels.
Increase oil temperature to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the blanched potatoes again in batches for 2-3 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on fresh paper towels. Immediately season with salt and any other desired spices while hot. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve with burgers, sandwiches, or as a snack with ketchup, mayo, or aioli.
For a gluten-free pub-style meal, serve with nachos and garlic bread.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Garlic Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice gluten-free bread into 1-inch thick slices, but do not cut all the way through the bottom crust, creating a pull-apart loaf. Or slice completely for individual pieces.
In a bowl, mix softened butter, minced garlic, parsley, salt, and Parmesan (if using) until well combined.
Spread the garlic butter generously between the slices and over the top of the loaf.
Wrap the loaf in foil (optional for softer bread) and bake for 10 minutes. For crispier edges, open foil and broil for the last 1-2 minutes.
Serve warm.
servingSuggestions: Essential side for any gluten-free pasta dish like Alfredo or Arrabiata.
Serve with soups or salads.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Nachos

ingredients.item: shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack cheese

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
On a large oven-safe platter or baking sheet, spread out a layer of tortilla chips.
Sprinkle half the cheese evenly over the chips. Scatter half the black beans and jalapeños.
Add another layer of chips and top with remaining cheese, beans, and jalapeños.
Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cheese is fully melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and immediately top with diced tomatoes, olives, dollops of sour cream and guacamole, salsa, and fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately while hot and crispy.
servingSuggestions: Perfect for game day or as a shareable appetizer. Pair with cold beer (gluten-free) or lime soda.
Add seasoned ground beef or grilled chicken for a non-vegetarian version.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Chocolate Cake

ingredients.item: vegetable oil or melted coconut oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line two 9-inch round cake pans.
In a large bowl, sift together gluten-free flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add eggs, milk, oil, and vanilla to the dry ingredients. Beat with a mixer on medium speed for 2 minutes.
Reduce speed and carefully add hot water/coffee. Mix until just combined (batter will be thin).
Divide batter evenly between prepared pans. Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Cool cakes in pans for 10 minutes, then invert onto a wire rack to cool completely.
For frosting: Beat softened butter until smooth. Gradually add powdered sugar, cocoa powder, milk, and vanilla, beating until light and fluffy.
Frost cooled cake layers. Decorate as desired.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a scoop of gluten-free vanilla ice cream and a drizzle of chocolate sauce.
Enjoy with a cup of cold coffee or a glass of milk.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Vanilla Ice Cream

ingredients.item: vanilla bean paste or pure vanilla extract

instructions: In a saucepan, combine cream, milk, and half the sugar. Heat over medium until just steaming (do not boil).
In a separate bowl, whisk egg yolks with remaining sugar and salt until pale and thick.
Slowly pour about 1 cup of the hot cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly to temper.

Pour the tempered yolk mixture back into the saucepan with the remaining cream. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon (about 170-175°F / 77-80°C).
Remove from heat. Stir in vanilla bean paste or extract.
Strain custard through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl. Cover and chill thoroughly in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Churn in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions until it reaches soft-serve consistency.
Transfer to an airtight container and freeze for at least 4 hours to firm up before serving.
servingSuggestions: Serve atop gluten-free chocolate cake or brownies.
Use in milkshakes, floats, or as a classic dessert on its own.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Gluten-Free Chocolate Brownie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 8x8 inch baking pan with parchment paper.
In a heatproof bowl over simmering water (double boiler), melt butter and 1/2 cup of the chocolate chips. Stir until smooth. Remove from heat.
Whisk sugar into the warm chocolate mixture. Then whisk in eggs, one at a time, followed by vanilla.
Sift gluten-free flour, cocoa powder, and salt directly into the wet ingredients. Fold gently until just combined.
Fold in remaining 1/2 cup chocolate chips and nuts (if using).
Spread batter evenly into prepared pan.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until the top is set and a toothpick inserted comes out with a few moist crumbs (not wet batter).
Let cool completely in the pan on a wire rack before cutting into squares.
servingSuggestions: Serve warm with a scoop of gluten-free vanilla ice cream.
Perfect with a glass of cold milk or cold coffee.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Cold Coffee

ingredients.item: strong brewed coffee or espresso, chilled

instructions: Brew coffee strong (use about 1.5 times the normal amount of grounds) and let it cool completely, or chill in the refrigerator.
In a blender, combine chilled coffee, milk, sugar, vanilla (if using), and ice cubes.
Blend on high speed until smooth and frothy.
Taste and adjust sweetness or coffee strength if needed.
Pour into glasses. Top with whipped cream if desired. Serve immediately with a straw.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a refreshing afternoon pick-me-up or after a meal.
Pair with gluten-free chocolate cake or brownies for a coffee break.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Fresh Lime Soda
instructions: Juice the limes to get about 1/2 cup of fresh lime juice.
If using sugar, muddle it with a splash of water or lime juice in the serving glass to dissolve. Simple syrup mixes easier.
Fill two glasses with ice cubes.
Divide lime juice and sugar/syrup between the glasses. Stir to combine.
Top each glass with chilled club soda, stirring gently.
Optional: Rim glass with salt by rubbing a lime wedge on the rim and dipping in salt before filling.
Garnish with a lime wheel or mint leaves. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: A perfect refreshing drink on a hot day. Pairs well with spicy foods like nachos or arrabiata pasta.
Add a splash of gin or vodka for an adult version.

GlutenFreeRecipes.name: Vanilla Milkshake
instructions: Ensure ice cream is slightly softened for easy blending.
In a blender, combine vanilla ice cream, milk, and vanilla extract.
Blend on medium speed until smooth and creamy. Add a little more milk if too thick.
Pour into two tall glasses.
Top generously with whipped cream, a cherry, and sprinkles if using.
Serve immediately with a straw and a long spoon.
servingSuggestions: Classic dessert drink. Serve with gluten-free fries or a burger for a retro diner experience.
Blend in cookies or fruit for variations like cookies & cream or strawberry shake.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Chicken Crust Pizza

ingredients.item: cooked chicken breast, shredded or ground

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix chicken, egg, parmesan, 1/4 cup mozzarella, salt, and garlic powder until well combined.
Press the mixture onto the parchment into a thin, even pizza crust shape.
Bake for 15 minutes until the edges are golden.
Remove from oven, spread sauce, add remaining cheese and toppings.
Bake for another 5-7 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
servingSuggestions: Serve hot with a side of keto ranch dressing for dipping.
Top with fresh basil after baking.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Veggie Cauliflower Pizza
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a pizza pan with parchment.
If using fresh cauliflower, pulse florets in a food processor into rice. Cook in microwave for 5-6 minutes, then squeeze out ALL excess moisture in a clean towel.
Mix cauliflower, egg, 1/2 cup mozzarella, parmesan, oregano, and salt until a dough forms.
Press dough into a crust on the pan. Bake for 15-18 minutes until firm and golden.
Add sauce, remaining cheese, and veggies. Bake 5-7 more minutes.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a sprinkle of red pepper flakes.
Pair with a side keto salad.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Cheese Burger (Lettuce Bun)

ingredients.item: large iceberg or butter lettuce leaves
sugar-free burger sauce (mayo + mustard + SF ketchup)

instructions: Season patty with salt and pepper. Cook on a skillet or grill to desired doneness.
Place cheese slice on patty near the end of cooking to melt.
Wash and dry lettuce leaves, using them as top and bottom buns.
Place patty on one lettuce leaf, add sauce and toppings, then top with the second leaf.
servingSuggestions: Serve with keto-friendly sweet potato fries (made with jicama or turnip).
Add crispy bacon or a fried egg on top.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Veg Burger (Paneer Patty)
instructions: Mix all ingredients (except lettuce) in a bowl until well combined.
Form into two firm patties.
Heat oil or butter in a pan over medium heat. Cook patties for 4-5 minutes per side until golden.
Serve each patty wrapped in two large lettuce leaves.
servingSuggestions: Top with a slice of tomato, onion, and mint chutney.
Serve with a side of cucumber raita.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Chicken Burger (No Bun)
instructions: Season chicken patty and cook in a skillet or grill until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Place cooked patty on a bed of leafy greens.
Top with avocado slices and bacon strips.
Drizzle with mayonnaise or your preferred keto-friendly sauce.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a side of grilled asparagus or zucchini fries.
Add a fried egg on top for extra protein.

KetoRecipes.name: Zucchini Alfredo Noodles
instructions: Spiralize zucchini and salt lightly. Let sit for 10 minutes, then pat VERY dry with paper towels to remove moisture.
In a skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat and stir in parmesan until melted and sauce thickens.
Add zucchini noodles and optional protein. Toss for 2-3 minutes until noodles are just tender but not mushy.
Season with salt and pepper.
servingSuggestions: Garnish with fresh parsley and extra parmesan.
Serve immediately to prevent noodles from getting watery.

KetoRecipes.name: Zucchini Arrabiata Pasta
instructions: Pat spiralized zucchini very dry with paper towels.
Heat olive oil in a pan. Sauté garlic and red pepper flakes for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinara sauce and simmer for 10-15 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add zucchini noodles and toss for 2-3 minutes until heated through but still al dente.
Season with salt and stir in fresh basil.
servingSuggestions: Top with grated parmesan or pecorino cheese.
Serve with a side of keto garlic bread (made with fathead dough).

KetoRecipes.name: Cauliflower Mac & Cheese

ingredients.item: cauliflower florets, cut into bite-sized pieces
pork rinds or almond flour for topping (optional)

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Steam or boil cauliflower until just tender (6-8 minutes). Drain well.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add cream, cream cheese, 1 1/2 cups cheddar, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir until smooth.
Combine sauce and cauliflower in a baking dish. Top with remaining cheese and optional topping.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until bubbly and golden on top.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a main dish with a side of grilled chicken.
Garnish with chopped chives or parsley.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Caesar Salad

ingredients.item: caesar dressing (mayo, anchovy paste, lemon, garlic, parmesan)

instructions: Wash and thoroughly dry romaine lettuce.
In a large bowl, toss lettuce with most of the dressing.
Top with grilled chicken, parmesan shavings, and optional bacon.
Drizzle with remaining dressing, season with black pepper, and serve.
servingSuggestions: Add keto croutons (made from baked cheese or almond flour bread).
Serve as a complete meal for lunch.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Greek Salad
instructions: Combine cucumber, tomatoes, onion, feta, and olives in a bowl.
In a small jar, shake together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to combine.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a refreshing side to grilled lamb or chicken.
Let it marinate for 30 minutes before serving for enhanced flavor.

KetoRecipes.name: Avocado Veggie Salad
instructions: Gently combine all diced vegetables and avocado in a bowl.
Drizzle with lime juice and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper, toss carefully to coat without mashing the avocado.
servingSuggestions: Eat immediately as a fresh side to any protein.
Top with grilled shrimp or salmon to make it a main course.

KetoRecipes.name: Cheese Crisps
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place small mounds (1 tbsp each) of cheese on the sheet, spaced apart.
Flatten slightly and sprinkle with optional seasoning.
Bake for 5-7 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Let cool completely on the sheet to crisp up.
servingSuggestions: Use as crackers for dips or as a salad topper.
Store in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

KetoRecipes.name: Garlic Butter Mushrooms

ingredients.item: button or cremini mushrooms, whole or halved

instructions: Clean mushrooms with a damp cloth.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5-7 minutes until they release water and start to brown.
Add garlic and cook for another 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in parsley, season with salt and pepper, and serve.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a side to steak or roasted chicken.
Top with a sprinkle of grated parmesan.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Nachos (Cheese Chips)

ingredients.item: toppings: ground beef (cooked), jalapeños, sour cream, guacamole

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment.
Make small piles of shredded cheese (about 2 tbsp each) on the sheet, flattening slightly.
Bake for 5-8 minutes until melted and edges are golden brown. Let cool to become crisp chips.
Arrange chips on a plate, top with seasoned ground beef and other desired toppings.
servingSuggestions: Serve immediately to prevent chips from getting soggy.
Drizzle with keto-friendly salsa or hot sauce.

KetoRecipes.name: Almond Flour Chocolate Cake

ingredients.item: granulated erythritol or monk fruit sweetener

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease an 8-inch round cake pan.
In a bowl, whisk almond flour, cocoa, sweetener, and baking powder.
In another bowl, beat eggs, then stir in melted butter, vanilla, and almond milk.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until smooth.
Pour batter into pan and bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely before serving.
servingSuggestions: Top with a keto chocolate ganache or whipped cream.
Dust with powdered erythritol and berries.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Vanilla Ice Cream

ingredients.item: granulated erythritol or monk fruit sweetener

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth and slightly thickened.
Pour into an ice cream maker and churn according to manufacturer's instructions (usually 20-30 minutes).
Transfer to a container and freeze for 2-3 hours to firm up.
servingSuggestions: Serve with keto brownies or fresh berries.
Drizzle with sugar-free chocolate syrup.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Chocolate Brownie
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 8x8 inch pan with parchment.
Whisk together almond flour, cocoa, sweetener, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk eggs, melted butter, and vanilla.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, fold in chocolate chips if using.
Spread batter in pan and bake for 20-25 minutes until set but still fudgy.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.
servingSuggestions: Serve with a scoop of keto vanilla ice cream.
Drizzle with almond butter or peanut butter.

KetoRecipes.name: Bulletproof Coffee
instructions: Brew a cup of coffee.
Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high for 20-30 seconds until frothy and creamy.
servingSuggestions: Drink as a breakfast replacement for sustained energy.
Enjoy warm; do not let it sit as the fats may separate.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Lemon Electrolyte Drink

ingredients.item: sea salt or pink Himalayan salt
liquid stevia or monk fruit drops

instructions: Combine all ingredients in a glass.
Stir or shake until salt is dissolved.
servingSuggestions: Drink during or after workouts to replenish electrolytes.
Serve over ice for a refreshing drink.

KetoRecipes.name: Keto Vanilla Milkshake (Almond Milk)
instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high until smooth and frothy.
servingSuggestions: Top with sugar-free whipped cream and a sprinkle of cinnamon.
Serve immediately for best texture.

MediterraneanRecipes.name: Hummus with Olive Oil

ingredients.item: extra virgin olive oil for serving

instructions: In a food processor, combine chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, 2 tbsp olive oil, cumin, and salt.
Blend until smooth, scraping down sides as needed.
While blending, gradually add ice water until desired creamy consistency is reached.
Taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt or lemon juice if needed.
Transfer to a shallow bowl, create swirls with a spoon, and drizzle with remaining olive oil. Garnish with paprika or sumac.
servingSuggestions: Serve as a dip with warm pita bread or fresh vegetables.
Use as a spread in sandwiches or wraps.

MediterraneanRecipes.name: Falafel
instructions: Soak dried chickpeas in cold water for 12-24 hours. Drain well.
In a food processor, combine soaked chickpeas, parsley, cilantro, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, baking powder, and salt. Pulse until mixture resembles coarse meal but holds together when pressed.
Transfer to bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour.
Form mixture into small patties or balls (about 1.5 inches in diameter).
Heat oil in deep pot to 350°F (175°C). Fry falafel in batches until deep golden brown (3-4 minutes).
Drain on paper towels. Serve hot.
servingSuggestions: Serve in pita pockets with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and tahini sauce.
Enjoy as part of a mezze platter with hummus and salad.

MediterraneanRecipes.name: Shawarma Wrap

ingredients.item: chicken thighs or beef sirloin, thinly sliced
shawarma spice blend (cumin, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom)

instructions: Marinate meat with yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, shawarma spices, and olive oil for at least 1 hour (preferably overnight).
Heat a skillet or grill pan over high heat. Cook marinated meat in batches until browned and cooked through.
Warm pita bread on a skillet or in the oven.
Spread tahini or garlic sauce on the bread.
Place cooked meat in center, top with tomato, onion, lettuce, and pickles.
Roll tightly into a wrap. Serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve with extra tahini sauce or garlic sauce on the side.
Accompany with fries or a side salad.

MediterraneanRecipes.name: Grilled Halloumi

ingredients.item: fresh mint or oregano leaves for garnish

instructions: Pat halloumi slices dry with paper towels.
Brush a grill pan or skillet with olive oil and heat over medium-high heat.
Place halloumi slices on the hot grill. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown grill marks appear.
Flip carefully and cook the other side.
Remove from heat and serve immediately.
servingSuggestions: Serve with lemon wedges and a drizzle of honey or pomegranate molasses.
Great as part of a mezze platter or on top of a Greek salad.

MediterraneanRecipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki

ingredients.item: boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into cubes

instructions: Soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes if using.
Combine olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl to make marinade.
Add chicken cubes, coat well, cover, and marinate in refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and charred in spots.
servingSuggestions: Serve with pita bread, tzatziki, sliced onions, tomatoes, and fries.
Can also be served over rice or in a salad bowl.

MediterraneanRecipes.name: Moussaka
instructions: Sprinkle eggplant slices with salt, let sit 30 minutes to release bitterness, then rinse and pat dry.
Brush eggplant (and potato if using) with olive oil and roast/broil until softened and lightly browned.
